Convert water use to cubic metres and divide by 2025 population. The tariff cancels when comparing, but applying it:

- Harrowfield: 7,146 ML × 1,000 × 142.35 ÷ 90,212 = 11,278.8 tenge/resident
- Ossbridge: 3,862 ML × 1,000 × 142.35 ÷ 52,904 = 10,393.9 tenge/resident
- Difference: 884.9 tenge/resident, rounded to 0 decimals.

ANSWER: Harrowfield | 885

Harrowfield used 7,146 ML = 7,146,000 m³. Ossbridge used 3,862 ML = 3,862,000 m³.

At 142.35 tenge/m³:

- Harrowfield: 7,146,000 × 142.35 ÷ 90,212 = 11,279.6 tenge per resident
- Ossbridge: 3,862,000 × 142.35 ÷ 52,904 = 10,391.4 tenge per resident

Difference: 888.2 tenge per resident, which rounds to 888.

ANSWER: Harrowfield | 888

Convert water use to cubic metres and multiply by the tariff; then divide by the 2025 population.

- Harrowfield: 7,146 ML = 7,146,000 m³  
  Cost per resident = \(7,146,000 \times 142.35 \div 90,212 \approx 11,276\) tenge
- Ossbridge: 3,862 ML = 3,862,000 m³  
  Cost per resident = \(3,862,000 \times 142.35 \div 52,904 \approx 10,391\) tenge

Difference: approximately \(11,276 - 10,391 = 885\) tenge per resident.

ANSWER: Harrowfield | 885
